title: India produces over 1.5M CS graduates annually, but scale is no longer an advantage with the rise of AI coding tools; Infosys revamps hiring to focus on AI (Saritha Rai/Bloomberg)
summary: Saritha Rai / Bloomberg: India produces over 1.5M CS graduates annually, but scale is no longer an advantage with the rise of AI coding tools; Infosys revamps hiring to focus on AI — Companies like Infosys are running their new hires through many weeks of training to bring them up to speed on new programming tools.
